info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Deposit Lending Virtual Account API
info.description: The Deposit Lending Virtual Account API provides access to detailed information about virtual accounts associated with deposit lending services. This API allows users to retrieve account balances, transaction histories, and other relevant account details. Common use cases include monitoring account activity, managing customer deposits, and integrating with financial management systems. Financial institutions and developers building applications in the banking and lending space will find this API essential for enhancing customer services and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific virtual account.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific virtual account identified by its unique account number. The information returned will aid in managing financial transactions associated with the virtual account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details regarding the virtual account with the specified account number ACC-200045. The information returned will include the current status, available balance, and other relevant account details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the virtual account details.

GetDepositLendingVirtualAccountAcc200045.description: Represents a request body for the GET operations related to the virtual account identified by ACC-200045 in the deposit lending service.
